text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"རྣམ་པར་བརྟགས་པའི་གཟུགས་གང་ཡིན་པ་དེ་ནི་རྣམ་པར་རྟོག་#པ་རྫས་སུ་ཡོད་པའི་ཕྱིར་རྫས་སུ་ཡོད་པར་བལྟ་བར་བྱ་","english":"Whatever is conceptualized form should be viewed as substantial, because conceptualization is substantial","kind":"sense","why":"The source says conceptualized form is viewed as substantial because conceptualization (the act) is substantial, but the English implies the form itself is substantial.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Whatever is conceptualized form should be viewed as substantial, because conceptualization is substantial
contradictions.why: The source says conceptualized form is viewed as substantial because conceptualization (the act) is substantial, but the English implies the form itself is substantial.
